info.title: GeoAPI
info.description: Public catalog API. Send Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_… from your server. List responses keep data and meta, and add collection. limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is an alias used only when limit is absent. Fuel consumption is litres per 100 km. The dimensions and performance groups are always null because this data is not collected yet. Colors returns every stored color with a verified flag. Document version 1.2.0 matches the deployed catalog. The TypeScript SDK, the MCP server, and the CLI (all 0.1.0) are not published yet. The host is https://geoapi.ge.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Public read-only vehicle catalog. GET only.

secretKey.description: Secret server key geoapi_sk_…. geoapi_pk_, a key in the URL query, a cookie, and a cabinet session are not accepted.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page size, from 1 to 1000. Default 100. per_page is ignored when limit is present.

perPage.name: per_page
perPage.description: Alias of limit. Ignored when limit is present.

direction.name: direction
direction.description: asc or desc. Default asc. Applied when sort is set.

q.name: q
q.description: Case-insensitive search, 1 to 100 characters. It searches the name; on generations also the chassis code, and on colors the color name. Control characters are rejected. Not accepted on years.

modifiedAfter.name: modified_after
modifiedAfter.description: UTC timestamp. Returns rows whose modified value is newer. Example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Not accepted on years or bodies.

yearFrom.name: year_from
yearFrom.description: Inclusive. Matches rows whose year_start to year_end range reaches this year or later. Rows without years always match. Integer from 1886 to 2100. A filter, not a field.

yearTo.name: year_to
yearTo.description: Inclusive. Matches rows whose year_start to year_end range starts in this year or earlier. Works alone or with year_from. Rows without years always match. Integer from 1886 to 2100.

body.name: body
body.description: Stored body type, up to 64 characters.

fuel.name: fuel
fuel.description: Stored fuel type, up to 64 characters.

drive.name: drive
drive.description: Stored drive type, up to 64 characters.

brandId.name: brand_id
brandId.description: Positive integer id from a brand response. Zero is rejected.

modelId.name: model_id
modelId.description: Positive integer id from a model response. Zero is rejected.

volumeFrom.name: volume_from
volumeFrom.description: Minimum engine volume in cubic centimetres, from 1 to 20000.

volumeTo.name: volume_to
volumeTo.description: Maximum engine volume in cubic centimetres, from 1 to 20000.

dimensions.description: Always null. Dimensions are not collected yet.

performance.description: Always null. Performance data is not collected yet. power_hp is in engine.

id.description: The model id. Several colors of one model share it, so it is not unique.

get.description:
Brand list. page defaults to 1. limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is the same parameter when limit is omitted. sort is name, id, or modified. direction is asc or desc. q searches the name.

Pagination: page defaults to 1 (maximum 1000000). limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is used only when limit is absent. direction defaults to asc and applies when sort is set. Without sort, this resource keeps its default order. REST year lists are ascending. The widget list starts with the newest year.

Authentication: send Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_… from your server. A key in the URL query, a cookie, or a cabinet session is not accepted. geoapi_pk_ is the widget key and does not work here. A cabinet personal access token with cars:read or * also needs X-CARAPI-PROJECT with the id of one of your active projects. A secret key ignores X-CARAPI-PROJECT. Before using a key, confirm your email and turn on the Cars API at /account/products, or the key gets 403.

Errors are JSON with only error.code and error.message, and no request id: 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 405 method_not_allowed, 422 invalid_parameter, 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, or MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, 503 unavailable. The key is checked before the method, so a non-GET request without a valid key returns 401, not 405. 405 is returned only after the key is accepted. Use GET. One IP address may send 300 requests a minute. That limit is checked before the key, so it can return 429 before 401.

Limits: a project shares 60 requests per UTC minute and its monthly quota with the widget. A project that has not chosen a paid plan has 10 000 successful requests per UTC month. Choosing the free plan sets that to 100. An unlimited plan sends X-Quota-Limit: unlimited. The daily limit of 2 000 successful requests is not enforced in production today. If the request cannot be counted, the API returns 503, never an unmetered success. Errors are not counted against the monthly quota. 404 and 422 still count toward the minute limit. On 429, wait Retry-After seconds. Do not retry 401, 403, 404, or 422. A success sends X-RateLimit-* for the minute and X-Quota-* for the month. 429 sends X-RateLimit-* for the limit that was hit.

Data: ids are strings. null means the value is unknown. dimensions and performance are always null. Colors include unchecked rows with verified false, and a color id is the model id. Photo rights are cleared, but the v1 API does not return photos yet. VIN lookup is not available.

Version 1.2.0 at https://geoapi.ge. The TypeScript SDK, the MCP server (stdio), and the CLI (all 0.1.0) are not published yet. The widget is the browser embed and uses geoapi_pk_.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional. One of name, id, modified. direction applies when sort is set.

X-Quota-Limit.description: An integer, or the word unlimited on an unlimited plan.

X-Quota-Remaining.description: An integer, or the word unlimited on an unlimited plan.

401.description: The key is missing, unknown, revoked, or expired.

403.description: The key is valid, but the project is disabled, the account is suspended, the email is not confirmed, or the Cars API is not turned on.

404.description: The record or the address was not found.

422.description: A parameter is invalid or is not accepted on this route.

503.description: The catalog or the request counter is temporarily unavailable.
